diagnosis.hypothesis: Initial validation showed only traffic to user1 (10.10.10.10) was failing, with ICMP redirects from leaf2 gateways toward 10.10.50.10. Reads confirmed hosts were addressed correctly and leaf2 had a bad static route for 10.10.10.0/24 via app1-facing 10.10.50.10. I changed leaf2 route 10.10.10.0/24 to next hop 10.255.0.4 toward leaf1. Final public success criteria validation passed with all lab connectivity checks successful.
diagnosis.reference: On leaf2, the static route to 10.10.10.0/24 (toward user1 in users_vlan) points to the wrong next hop 10.10.50.10, an address on the wrong egress instead of the path via leaf1.

arguments.reason: Validation showed only paths to user1 fail, with ICMP redirects from leaf2 gateways toward 10.50.10.10. Running config on leaf2 has static route 10.10.10.0/24 pointing incorrectly to app1 (10.10.50.10) instead of toward leaf1 via the inter-leaf fabric.
